description:
About Us: Joining the Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge to build an interactive storytelling platform about NASA equipment on the MOON and MARS. Why Join: Clear vision, beginner-friendly, focus on UI/UX, story and pitch.

Looking For: UI/UX Designers, Web/No-Code Developers, Content Storytellers, and Presenters. Join us!
summary:
### Project Summary

Our team developed an interactive website called **“Abandoned but Not Forgotten”**, focused on NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. The main purpose of our project is to present this topic in an engaging, educational, and accessible way.

Our website allows users to explore information about abandoned space equipment through an interactive experience rather than simply reading long blocks of text. We believe this approach makes learning more interesting, helps visitors understand the history of space exploration, and raises awareness about the objects humans have left beyond Earth.

This project is valuable for the challenge because it combines technology, education, and creativity to communicate an important scientific topic. It encourages people to look beyond the achievements of space missions and consider what remains after they end. Our goal is to turn forgotten equipment into meaningful stories that people can explore and learn from.
details:
Lunar Mission Interactive Atlas — Project Details

  • What it does: An interactive 2D orthographic map of the Moon displaying historical landing sites, abandoned spacecraft, rovers (LRV), and probes from NASA and Soviet missions (1964–1972) with timeline filtering and mission info cards.
  • Benefits: Runs offline in a single lightweight HTML file (index.html), requires zero setup, and renders crisp HiDPI graphics across all devices.
  • Intended impact: To make space exploration history visually engaging and accessible for STEM education, classrooms, and science showcases.
  • Tools & Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, HTML5 Canvas 2D API, and Visual Studio Code.
  • Creativity: Uses custom-built procedural terrain generation (craters, lunar maria, ray systems) and an interactive chronological time-travel slider instead of heavy external 3D engines.
  • Factors considered: Scientific accuracy (using real NASA NSSDC, ALSJ, and LROC coordinates), smooth UX/navigation, and instant one-click deployment for judges.
dataRefs: Что оттуда взято: Общие каталожные данные, официальные названия и принадлежность к космическим агентствам для беспилотных аппаратов (Ranger 7, Луна-9, Surveyor 1, Surveyor 3, Луна-17 / Луноход-1), а также годы их запуска и посадки.

Что оттуда взято: Исторические справки, описания миссий, названия регионов и технические детали для всех пилотируемых экспедиций программы «Аполлон» (Apollo 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17), включая данные о посадочных модулях и лунных автомобилях (LRV)

Что оттуда взято: Точные селенографические координаты (широта lat и долгота lon) для всех точек на поверхности Луны, выверенные по снимкам высокого разрешения с орбитального зонда LRO (Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter).
